title: Waikiki Turtle Snorkeling & 6-in-1 Adventure with Free Pickup
includes: Pickup and drop off (Pickup service is available only within the Waikiki area.)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children under 2 years old may board for free but must be accompanied by an adult, and entering the water is not permitted.
Cancellation/Refund Policy - If you notify us by the day of departure (2~days): No cancellation/refund

First-time snorkelers and less-confident swimmers are welcome. Life jackets are provided, and our experienced crew can assist guests in the water using flotation boards, helping you enjoy the snorkeling experience more comfortably and confidently.
Guests who are prone to motion sickness are advised to take motion sickness medication before boarding.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience a special turtle snorkeling adventure in Waikiki aboard a smooth and comfortable catamaran.
This all-in-one 6-in-1 ocean tour includes snorkeling, kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding (SUP), sea scooters, and more—offering a full range of water activities in a single trip. All equipment is provided, and our friendly crew will guide you every step of the way, making it safe and enjoyable even for first-time participants.
Dive into the clear, warm waters of Waikiki and discover vibrant tropical fish and Hawaiian green sea turtles up close. From the boat, you can also capture unforgettable photos with the iconic Diamond Head as your backdrop.
During the tour, relax and take in the beautiful ocean scenery. With a bit of luck, you may spot dolphins, and during whale season, you might even see humpback whales.
This is a must-do experience in Waikiki—an unforgettable combination of adventure, relaxation, and ocean activities all in one tour.
